#!/bin/bash

# Log file path
LOG_FILE="/workspace/cpu_monitor.log"

# Start monitoring
echo "Monitoring CPU usage..." > "$LOG_FILE"
echo "Start Time: $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

# Sample CPU usage every 5 seconds for 1 minute
for i in {1..12}; do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date)
    CPU_USAGE=$(top -bn1 | grep "Cpu(s)" | sed "s/.*, *\\([0-9.]*\)%* id.*/\1/" | awk '{print 100 - $1}')
    echo "[$TIMESTAMP] CPU: $CPU_USAGE%" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    sleep 5
done

echo "Monitoring completed at: $(date)" >> "$LOG_FILE"
